items.title_zh: 2023年全球心理疾病流行趋势及负担更新分析
items.summary_zh: 2023年全球疾病负担研究（GBD）评估了375种疾病和伤害的流行率、发病率及健康负担，其中包括12种心理疾病。本文分析了1990年至2023年间，心理疾病在不同性别、年龄组、21个地区及204个国家和地区的流行趋势和负担。研究涵盖的心理疾病包括焦虑症、重度抑郁症、心境恶劣症、双相障碍、精神分裂症、自闭症谱系障碍、行为障碍、注意缺陷多动障碍、厌食症、贪食症、特发性发育智力障碍及其他心理疾病。通过文献回顾和贝叶斯元回归分析，估算了各疾病的流行率，并结合残疾权重计算了残疾生活年（YLDs）。厌食症导致的死亡则通过死亡原因集成建模策略进行评估，最终结果为各性别、年龄、地点和年份的死亡人数。
items.l1_lead: 2023年全球心理疾病流行趋势分析显示，心理疾病在不同性别、年龄和地区的负担持续加重，尤其是焦虑症和重度抑郁症的发病率显著上升。
items.l2_summary:
2023年全球疾病负担研究（GBD）对375种疾病和伤害的流行率、发病率及健康负担进行了评估，其中包括12种心理疾病。研究分析了1990年至2023年间心理疾病在不同性别、年龄组、21个地区及204个国家和地区的流行趋势和负担。涵盖的心理疾病包括焦虑症、重度抑郁症、心境恶劣症、双相障碍、精神分裂症、自闭症谱系障碍、行为障碍、注意缺陷多动障碍、厌食症、贪食症、特发性发育智力障碍及其他心理疾病。

通过文献回顾和贝叶斯元回归分析，研究估算了各心理疾病的流行率，并结合残疾权重计算了残疾生活年（YLDs）。这一方法使得研究能够更全面地评估心理疾病对社会的影响，尤其是在不同性别和年龄段的表现差异。厌食症导致的死亡人数则通过死亡原因集成建模策略进行评估，确保了数据的准确性和可靠性。

研究结果显示，心理疾病的流行率在过去几十年中呈现出显著的变化，尤其是在年轻人群体中，焦虑症和重度抑郁症的发病率显著上升。此外，性别差异也在不同心理疾病中表现明显，例如，女性在焦虑症和抑郁症的发病率上普遍高于男性，而男性则在某些行为障碍中表现出更高的发病率。这些数据为政策制定者和公共卫生专家提供了重要的参考依据，以便更好地应对心理健康问题。

总的来说，该研究不仅揭示了心理疾病的流行趋势和负担，还强调了对不同人群的关注和干预的必要性。随着心理健康问题的日益严重，全球范围内的公共卫生政策需要更加重视心理疾病的预防和治疗，以减轻其对社会和个体的影响。

items.title: Why Early, Large-scale Weight Loss Is the Future of Type 2 Diabetes Care.
items.body: Type 2 diabetes has traditionally been viewed as a chronic, progressive condition. However, recent innovations, such as accessible low-calorie diets and newer weight loss medications, are challenging this paradigm. Evidence from clinical trials and mechanistic studies indicates that intentional weight loss, especially early in the disease course, can meaningfully alter its trajectory through reducing ectopic fat and glycemic levels. New medications that reduce "food noise" are particularly valuable in today's obesogenic environments, helping patients regain some control over calorie intake and supporting sustainable lifestyle changes. These therapies can lead to weight loss of ≥10% in type 2 diabetes and may enable newly diagnosed individuals to achieve and maintain normoglycemia for many years. Early, substantial weight loss combined with glycemic normalization has the potential to extend life expectancy, reduce or delay complications associated with obesity and hyperglycemia, improve quality of life, and lower long-term care needs. Beyond weight reduction, additional health benefits are offered by these medications, as they also slow atherosclerosis and preserve kidney function. Building on recent American Diabetes Association-European Association for the Study of Diabetes guideline recommendations, we propose that intentional weight loss at or near the time of diagnosis be considered a central strategy in type 2 diabetes management. To support this shift, proof-of-concept trials should be conducted for assessment of the long-term efficacy and durability of this approach. With success, increased competition and broader access to weight loss medications could lower costs and expand availability-even in low- and middle-income countries, where diabetes rates are rising rapidly-supporting a transformative change in the global standard of care.
items.authors: Sattar N, Buse JB.
items.title_zh: 早期大规模减重是2型糖尿病护理的未来
items.summary_zh: 2型糖尿病传统上被视为一种慢性进展性疾病。然而，近期的创新，如可获得的低热量饮食和新型减重药物，正在挑战这一观念。临床试验和机制研究的证据表明，特别是在疾病早期，故意减重可以通过减少异位脂肪和血糖水平显著改变疾病进程。在当今肥胖环境中，能够减少“食物噪音”的新药物尤为重要，帮助患者重新控制热量摄入并支持可持续的生活方式改变。这些疗法可以使2型糖尿病患者的体重减少≥10%，并可能使新诊断的个体在多年内实现并维持正常血糖水平。早期显著减重结合血糖正常化有潜力延长寿命，减少或延缓与肥胖和高血糖相关的并发症，提高生活质量，并降低长期护理需求。此外，这些药物还提供了额外的健康益处，如减缓动脉粥样硬化和保护肾功能。基于近期美国糖尿病协会-欧洲糖尿病研究协会的指南建议，我们提议在诊断时或接近诊断时进行故意减重。
items.l1_lead: 早期大规模减重结合血糖正常化有潜力显著改善2型糖尿病患者的健康状况，延长寿命并提高生活质量。
items.l2_summary:
2型糖尿病传统上被视为一种慢性进展性疾病，但近期的研究和临床试验表明，早期大规模减重可能是改善这一疾病护理的未来方向。随着可获得的低热量饮食和新型减重药物的出现，研究者们发现，特别是在疾病早期，故意减重能够显著改变疾病进程，主要通过减少异位脂肪和降低血糖水平来实现。这些新药物在当今肥胖环境中尤为重要，它们能够帮助患者减少“食物噪音”，重新控制热量摄入，并支持可持续的生活方式改变。

研究显示，这些疗法可以使2型糖尿病患者的体重减少≥10%，并可能使新诊断的个体在多年内实现并维持正常的血糖水平。早期显著减重结合血糖正常化，不仅有助于延长患者的寿命，还能减少或延缓与肥胖和高血糖相关的并发症，提高生活质量，并降低长期护理的需求。此外，这些新药物还提供了额外的健康益处，例如减缓动脉粥样硬化和保护肾功能。

基于近期美国糖尿病协会（ADA）和欧洲糖尿病研究协会（EASD）的指南建议，研究者们提议在患者被诊断时或接近诊断时进行故意减重。这一策略的实施可能会为2型糖尿病的管理带来革命性的变化，强调了早期干预的重要性，从而为患者提供更好的健康前景。总之，早期大规模减重不仅是2型糖尿病护理的未来，更是改善患者生活质量和健康状况的重要途径。

items.title: Impact of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitors on Quality of Life and Patient-Reported Outcomes in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.body: Background Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors improve glycemic and cardiovascular outcomes in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). However, their impact on quality of life (QoL) and patient-reported outcomes (PROs) has not been systematically evaluated. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to assess the effect of SGLT2 inhibitors on QoL in patients with T2DM. Methods MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Cochrane and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched until 18 August 2025 for randomised controlled trials and post hoc analyses of SGLT2 inhibitors reporting validated QoL or PRO outcomes in adults with T2DM. A random-effects model was used to estimate mean differences (MD) or odds ratios (OR) with 95% CIs. Subgroup analyses compared SGLT2 inhibitors with placebo and active comparators. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane RoB-2 tool. Results Ten studies including 5294 patients (SGLT2i: 2807; control: 2487) were included. SGLT2 inhibitors significantly improved: EQ-5D Index score versus placebo (MD: 0.04, p = 0.008), DTR-QoL against active comparators (MD: 6.99; p = 0.0006), DTSQ compared to active comparators (MD: 0.54; p = 0.006) and IWQoL (MD: 1.44; p = 0.005) versus placebo. Improvements were also observed in SHIELD WQ-9 overall QoL (OR: 2.11; p = 0.005), emotional health (OR: 2.16; p = 0.006), self-esteem (OR: 2.26; p = 0.006) and work performance (OR: 1.99; p = 0.04) compared with placebo. Conclusion Randomised evidence suggests SGLT2 inhibitors enhance EQ-5D Index score, diabetes-specific QoL and several PROs in T2DM, particularly in physical, emotional and treatment satisfaction domains, supporting their earlier use in this population.
items.authors: Ahmed M, Shaikh N, Ibrahim S, Shafiq SB, Atta S, Naveed MA, Shafqat S, Sattar N, Basit A.
items.title_zh: 钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白2抑制剂对2型糖尿病患者生活质量的影响
items.summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在评估钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白2（SGLT2）抑制剂对2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者生活质量（QoL）和患者报告结果（PROs）的影响。我们检索了MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Cochrane和ClinicalTrials.gov，纳入了5294名患者的10项随机对照试验及后续分析。结果显示，SGLT2抑制剂显著改善了EQ-5D指数分数（MD: 0.04, p = 0.008）、DTR-QoL（MD: 6.99; p = 0.0006）、DTSQ（MD: 0.54; p = 0.006）和IWQoL（MD: 1.44; p = 0.005）。此外，在SHIELD WQ-9整体QoL、情感健康、自尊和工作表现方面也观察到了显著改善。这些结果表明，SGLT2抑制剂不仅有助于改善血糖和心血管结果，还能显著提升患者的生活质量。
items.l1_lead: 钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白2抑制剂显著改善2型糖尿病患者的生活质量和患者报告结果，提升了多项健康相关指标。
items.l2_summary:
本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在探讨钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白2（SGLT2）抑制剂对2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者生活质量（QoL）及患者报告结果（PROs）的影响。研究通过检索MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Cochrane和ClinicalTrials.gov，纳入了5294名患者的10项随机对照试验及后续分析。结果显示，SGLT2抑制剂在多个生活质量指标上均表现出显著改善。具体而言，EQ-5D指数分数的平均差（MD）为0.04，p值为0.008，表明患者的整体健康状况有所提升。此外，DTR-QoL（糖尿病相关生活质量问卷）的MD为6.99，p值为0.0006，显示出患者在生活质量方面的显著改善。DTSQ（糖尿病治疗满意度问卷）的MD为0.54，p值为0.006，进一步反映了患者对治疗的满意度提高。IWQoL（肥胖患者生活质量问卷）的MD为1.44，p值为0.005，说明患者在生活质量的各个方面均有积极变化。

此外，在SHIELD WQ-9整体生活质量、情感健康、自尊和工作表现等方面也观察到了显著改善。这些结果表明，SGLT2抑制剂不仅能够有效改善患者的血糖控制和心血管健康，还能显著提升患者的生活质量。综上所述，SGLT2抑制剂在改善T2DM患者的生活质量方面具有重要的临床意义，值得在临床实践中推广应用。

items.title: Cardiovascular risk in MASLD: What multiple lines of evidence reveal.
items.body: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is associated with increased cardiovascular risk, yet whether it independently confers risk beyond established cardiometabolic factors remains debated. Herein, we critically appraise epidemiological, genetic, mechanistic, and large-cohort evidence. Many studies reporting independent associations are limited by small sample sizes, heterogeneous cardiovascular outcomes, potential selection and publication bias, and perhaps most importantly, incomplete adjustment for established continuous cardiovascular risk factors. Mendelian randomisation and large-scale cohort data suggest that excess liver fat per se is not independently atherogenic; rather, accompanying abnormalities in lipid profiles mediate the observed risk. Notably, no current cardiovascular risk model includes MASLD as an independent variable. Clinically, MASLD identifies individuals with higher than average cardiovascular risk who are frequently undertreated with preventive therapies. Thus, the priority for primary care physicians, hepatologists, endocrinologists, and cardiologists, among others, should be to adequately determine (using risk scores), communicate on and address the cardiovascular and related multimorbidity challenges inherent in MASLD care.
items.authors: Sattar N, Dalakoti M, Alazawi W, Aroda VR.
items.title_zh: MASLD与心血管风险的多重证据分析
items.summary_zh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病（MASLD）与心血管风险增加相关，但其是否独立于已知心脏代谢因素外仍存在争议。本文对流行病学、遗传学、机制及大规模队列研究的证据进行了批判性评估。许多报告独立关联的研究样本量小，心血管结果异质，可能存在选择和发表偏倚，且对已知心血管风险因素的调整不够充分。孟德尔随机化和大规模队列数据表明，肝脏脂肪过多本身并不独立致动脉粥样硬化，而是伴随的脂质异常介导了观察到的风险。目前没有心血管风险模型将MASLD作为独立变量。临床上，MASLD识别出心血管风险高于平均水平的个体，但这些个体常常未得到足够的预防治疗。因此，初级保健医生、肝病学家、内分泌学家和心脏病专家等应优先使用风险评分，充分沟通并解决MASLD护理中固有的心血管及相关多重疾病挑战。
items.l1_lead: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病（MASLD）与心血管风险相关，但其独立性存争议，需加强风险评估与临床干预。
items.l2_summary:
代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病（MASLD）与心血管风险增加之间的关系引发了广泛关注，但其是否独立于已知心脏代谢因素仍存在争议。本文对流行病学、遗传学、机制及大规模队列研究的证据进行了批判性评估，指出许多研究样本量较小，心血管结果存在异质性，可能受到选择和发表偏倚的影响，且对已知心血管风险因素的调整不足。通过孟德尔随机化和大规模队列数据的分析，研究发现肝脏脂肪过多本身并不独立导致动脉粥样硬化，而是伴随的脂质异常在观察到的风险中起到了中介作用。目前尚无心血管风险模型将MASLD作为独立变量进行评估。

尽管MASLD能够识别出心血管风险高于平均水平的个体，但这些个体往往未能得到足够的预防治疗。因此，初级保健医生、肝病学家、内分泌学家和心脏病专家等应优先使用风险评分工具，充分沟通并解决MASLD护理中固有的心血管及相关多重疾病挑战。这一研究强调了在临床实践中对MASLD患者的风险评估和管理的重要性，提示医疗专业人员需要更加关注MASLD与心血管健康之间的复杂关系。

items.title: Incretin Mimetics in Cancer and Cardiovascular Disease: JACC: CardioOncology State-of-the-Art Review.
items.body: Incretin mimetics (glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists and dual glucagon-like peptide-1/glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide receptor agonists) are paradigm changing for managing obesity, diabetes, and cardiovascular risk. These phenotypes are also associated with elevated risk for numerous cancers. Limited research suggests that incretin mimetics may be associated with lower risk for developing several cancers. However, more translational and randomized clinical data are needed for confirmation. Patients with cancer were excluded from trials of incretin mimetics. Therefore, their effects on adipose tissue, muscle, cardiovascular risk factors, and outcomes in this population are unknown. Notwithstanding contraindications with a history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2, translational data also promote the hypothesis that incretin mimetics could slow the growth of other cancers. Further clinical data are needed to determine which patients undergoing cancer treatment might experience benefit or harm from the anthropometric and calorie reduction effects of incretin mimetics or display cardiometabolic benefit despite the competing risk for cancer death.
items.authors: Leong D, Gong S, Sattar N, Narayan V, Reizine NM, Gerstein H, Vellky J.
items.title_zh: 胰高血糖素样肽模仿物在癌症与心血管疾病中的应用
items.summary_zh: 胰高血糖素样肽模仿物（如胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂和双重胰高血糖素样肽-1/葡萄糖依赖性胰岛素促分泌多肽受体激动剂）在管理肥胖、糖尿病和心血管风险方面具有变革性意义。这些表型与多种癌症的风险升高相关。有限的研究表明，胰高血糖素样肽模仿物可能与降低某些癌症的发生风险相关，但尚需更多的转化研究和随机临床数据来确认。癌症患者被排除在胰高血糖素样肽模仿物的临床试验之外，因此其对该人群的脂肪组织、肌肉、心血管风险因素及结果的影响尚不明确。尽管存在对髓样甲状腺癌或多发性内分泌肿瘤2型的禁忌症，转化数据仍支持胰高血糖素样肽模仿物可能减缓其他癌症的生长。需要进一步的临床数据来确定在癌症治疗中，哪些患者可能从胰高血糖素样肽模仿物的体型和卡路里减少效果中获益或受到伤害，或在面临癌症死亡风险的情况下显示心代谢益处。
items.l1_lead: 胰高血糖素样肽模仿物在管理肥胖和心血管风险方面具有潜力，但其对癌症患者的影响尚需更多研究确认。
items.l2_summary:
胰高血糖素样肽模仿物（GLP-1 mimetics），如胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂和双重胰高血糖素样肽-1/葡萄糖依赖性胰岛素促分泌多肽受体激动剂，在管理肥胖、糖尿病及心血管风险方面展现出变革性的潜力。这些代谢表型与多种癌症的风险升高存在关联，尽管目前的研究相对有限，但已有初步证据表明，胰高血糖素样肽模仿物可能与某些癌症的发生风险降低相关。然而，关于其在癌症患者中的应用，现有的临床试验往往将其排除在外，因此尚不清楚这些药物对癌症患者的脂肪组织、肌肉及心血管风险因素的具体影响。

尽管对髓样甲状腺癌或多发性内分泌肿瘤2型患者存在使用禁忌，转化研究数据仍然支持胰高血糖素样肽模仿物可能在减缓其他类型癌症的生长方面发挥作用。为了更好地理解这些药物在癌症治疗中的潜在益处，未来需要更多的临床数据来明确哪些患者能够从胰高血糖素样肽模仿物的体重和卡路里减少效果中获益，或可能面临的风险。此外，研究还需探讨在癌症死亡风险的背景下，这些药物是否能够提供心代谢方面的益处。总的来说，尽管胰高血糖素样肽模仿物在治疗肥胖和糖尿病方面的应用前景广阔，但其在癌症患者中的具体效果和安全性仍需进一步深入研究。

items.title: Designing Next-Generation Cardiometabolic Outcome Trials for Obesity Medicines.
items.body: The prevalence of obesity has reached pandemic proportions and is having enormous public health effects. Obesity increases the risk of type 2 diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, and cardiovascular (CV) disease including coronary artery disease, heart failure, atrial fibrillation, and stroke. Although initial randomized clinical trials of weight-loss strategies through diet and exercise or early medical therapies did not lead to improved CV outcomes, more recent trials using glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists in individuals with obesity have demonstrated CV benefits. At present, there are multiple cardiovascular outcome trials (CVOTs) of novel GLP-1 receptor agonists and investigational products targeting multiple hormonal pathways planned or underway. However, the optimal design features of CVOTs testing novel obesity medications may need to evolve. In this commentary, we discuss regulatory aspects and study design considerations of CVOTs for obesity medications in the context of previous and ongoing clinical trials and the future of CVOTs targeting obesity. We also propose 5 principles to help guide next-generation cardio-kidney-metabolic outcome trials.
items.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
items.authors: Platz E, Peikert A, Bozkurt B, Van der Schueren B, Butler J, Lingvay I, McGuire DK, Zannad F, Sattar N.
items.title_zh: 设计下一代肥胖药物心血管代谢结果试验
items.summary_zh: 肥胖的流行已达到大流行水平，对公共健康产生了巨大影响。肥胖增加了2型糖尿病、高血压、慢性肾病和心血管疾病（如冠心病、心力衰竭、房颤和中风）的风险。尽管早期的随机临床试验未能改善心血管结果，但近期使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂的试验显示出心血管益处。目前，针对新型GLP-1受体激动剂和多种激素通路的研究产品，已有多个心血管结果试验（CVOTs）在计划或进行中。然而，测试新型肥胖药物的CVOTs的最佳设计特征可能需要演变。本文讨论了肥胖药物CVOTs的监管方面和研究设计考虑，并提出了五项原则，以指导下一代心脏-肾脏-代谢结果试验。
items.l1_lead: 肥胖药物的心血管结果试验需演变设计，提出五项原则以指导下一代心脏-肾脏-代谢研究，旨在改善心血管健康。
items.l2_summary:
肥胖的流行已成为全球公共健康的一大挑战，显著增加了2型糖尿病、高血压、慢性肾病和多种心血管疾病（如冠心病、心力衰竭、房颤和中风）的风险。尽管早期的随机临床试验未能显示出肥胖药物对心血管结果的改善，但近期的研究表明，使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂的治疗可能带来心血管益处。目前，针对新型GLP-1受体激动剂及其他多种激素通路的研究产品，已有多个心血管结果试验（CVOTs）在计划或进行中。

然而，设计新型肥胖药物的CVOTs时，最佳设计特征可能需要不断演变。本文讨论了肥胖药物CVOTs的监管要求和研究设计的考虑因素，并提出了五项原则，以指导下一代心脏-肾脏-代谢结果试验的设计。这些原则旨在确保试验的科学性和有效性，从而为肥胖治疗的未来发展提供坚实的基础。

通过对现有研究的分析，作者强调了在设计CVOTs时需要关注的关键要素，包括样本量、研究时间框架、终点事件的选择以及患者的基线特征等。这些因素不仅影响试验的结果，还可能对药物的市场准入和临床应用产生深远影响。因此，合理的设计和严谨的实施将是推动肥胖药物研发的重要环节。

总之，随着肥胖问题的日益严重，开发有效的肥胖药物并评估其心血管代谢结果的试验设计显得尤为重要。通过遵循提出的五项原则，研究人员能够更好地设计和实施CVOTs，为肥胖患者提供更安全有效的治疗方案。

items.title: Hallmarks and correlates of effective adoptive cell immunotherapy for cancer.
items.body: Cancer immunotherapies have shown promise and success in a number of different types of tumours, yet many solid epithelial tumours remain recalcitrant. Somatic mutations in tumour cells can lead to the expression of neoantigens, which are potent targets of the human antitumour immune response. These can be targeted through adoptive cell transfer (ACT) of neoantigen-specific T cells, including tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) or T cell receptor (TCR)-engineered T cells (TCR-T cells), an approach that has been shown to achieve tumour regression in patients with different types of metastatic solid tumours including melanoma, breast and gastrointestinal cancer. Immunogenomics, systems immunology and genome editing now provide multidisciplinary tools to design cell therapies against solid cancer. Here, we review historical efforts and our current conceptual understanding of ACT using TILs or TCR-T cells. Moreover, we highlight emerging correlates of response to ACT and novel strategies that integrate tumour immunology, cancer genomics, computational biology and T cell engineering for the development of next-generation cellular immunotherapies.
items.authors: Krishna S, Robbins PF, Lowery FJ, Rosenberg SA.
items.title_zh: 有效细胞免疫治疗癌症的标志与相关性
items.summary_zh: 癌症免疫治疗在多种肿瘤类型中展现出希望与成功，但许多实体上皮肿瘤仍然顽固。肿瘤细胞中的体细胞突变可导致新抗原（neoantigens）的表达，这些新抗原是人类抗肿瘤免疫反应的强大靶点。通过转移特异性针对新抗原的T细胞（如肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞TILs或T细胞受体工程T细胞TCR-T细胞）进行的细胞转移（ACT）已在多种转移性实体肿瘤患者中显示出肿瘤缩小的效果。免疫基因组学、系统免疫学和基因组编辑为设计针对实体癌症的细胞治疗提供了多学科工具。本文回顾了使用TILs或TCR-T细胞的ACT的历史努力及当前概念理解，并强调了对ACT反应的新相关性及整合肿瘤免疫学、癌症基因组学、计算生物学和T细胞工程的新策略，以推动下一代细胞免疫治疗的发展。
items.l1_lead: 新抗原在细胞免疫治疗癌症中扮演关键角色，转移特异性T细胞治疗显示出对多种转移性实体肿瘤的有效性，推动了癌症治疗的新策略。
items.l2_summary:
癌症免疫治疗在多种肿瘤类型中展现出希望与成功，然而对于许多实体上皮肿瘤而言，治疗效果仍然不尽如人意。肿瘤细胞中的体细胞突变能够导致新抗原（neoantigens）的表达，这些新抗原成为人类抗肿瘤免疫反应的重要靶点。通过转移特异性针对新抗原的T细胞进行的细胞转移（ACT，adoptive cell transfer），如肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（TILs，tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes）或T细胞受体工程T细胞（TCR-T cells），在多种转移性实体肿瘤患者中已显示出肿瘤缩小的效果。这一过程的成功依赖于免疫基因组学、系统免疫学和基因组编辑等多学科工具的结合，为设计针对实体癌症的细胞治疗提供了新的可能性。

本文回顾了使用TILs或TCR-T细胞的ACT的历史努力及当前的概念理解，强调了对ACT反应的新相关性。研究表明，整合肿瘤免疫学、癌症基因组学、计算生物学和T细胞工程的新策略，能够推动下一代细胞免疫治疗的发展。这些新策略不仅有助于提高治疗的有效性，还可能为未来的癌症治疗提供更为精准的解决方案。通过对新抗原的深入研究和T细胞的工程化改造，科学家们希望能够克服目前实体肿瘤治疗中的挑战，进一步提升细胞免疫治疗的成功率。总之，尽管当前的研究仍在不断进展，但通过多学科的协作与创新，细胞免疫治疗在癌症治疗中的前景依然令人期待。

items.title: The chemistry of habitable oceans in the Solar system.
items.body: Liquid water exists on the Earth and several other planetary bodies in our solar system. The chemical character of these aqueous reservoirs is central to evaluating their habitability. Here, we synthesize the chemical features of water reservoirs and their biological implications on the modern Earth. We then outline constraints on the evolutionary history of Earth's ocean chemistry and discuss its interplay with the biosphere. Furthermore, we examine the inferred chemical environments of water bodies on early Mars, dwarf planet Ceres, Jupiter's moon Europa and Saturn's moons Enceladus and Titan. We conclude by outlining priority questions for future planetary habitability studies.
items.authors: Hao J, Zhu Y, Knoll AH, Tosca NJ, He C, Vetter MCYL, Liao L, Crockford PW, Stüeken EE, Huo A, Li J, Mondal JA, Catling DC, Song Y, Ju P, Pan L, Huang F, Glein CR.
items.title_zh: 太阳系可居住海洋的化学特征
items.summary_zh: 液态水存在于地球及我们太阳系的多个天体上，这些水体的化学特征对于评估其可居住性至关重要。本文综合了现代地球水体的化学特征及其生物学影响，概述了地球海洋化学的演化历史及其与生物圈的相互作用。此外，我们还考察了早期火星、矮行星谷神星、木星的欧罗巴卫星以及土星的恩克拉多斯和泰坦卫星的水体化学环境。最后，我们提出了未来行星科学研究的优先问题。
items.l1_lead: 本文探讨了太阳系内多个天体液态水的化学特征及其对可居住性的影响，强调了地球海洋化学演化与生物圈的相互作用。
items.l2_summary:
液态水的存在是评估太阳系内多个天体可居住性的关键因素，尤其是在地球及其他天体的水体化学特征方面。本文综合了现代地球水体的化学特征及其对生物圈的影响，探讨了地球海洋化学的演化历史以及其与生物圈之间的相互作用。地球的海洋化学特征经历了漫长的演变过程，这一过程不仅影响了地球的气候和环境，也为生命的起源和演化提供了必要的条件。

在对其他天体的研究中，早期火星的水体化学环境显示出与地球相似的特征，尽管火星的环境条件较为严酷。矮行星谷神星的水体则展现出独特的化学成分，可能为生命的存在提供了潜在的条件。木星的欧罗巴卫星被认为拥有一个覆盖在冰层下的液态水海洋，其化学环境可能支持微生物的生存。土星的恩克拉多斯和泰坦卫星同样具有液态水的存在，恩克拉多斯的喷流中发现了有机分子，暗示其水体化学环境的复杂性和潜在的生物可居住性。

通过对这些天体的水体化学环境的考察，本文提出了未来行星科学研究的优先问题，强调了深入了解这些天体的水体化学特征对于寻找外星生命的重要性。这些研究不仅有助于我们理解地球自身的演化过程，也为探索其他星体的可居住性提供了重要的科学依据。总之，水体的化学特征是评估太阳系内天体可居住性的基础，未来的研究将继续聚焦于这些化学特征与生命之间的关系。

items.title: Preparation of an activatable benzothiadiazole-based nanoprobe for multispectral optoacoustic and NIR-II fluorescence dual-mode imaging of liver injury.
items.body: Light-excited dual-mode imaging that integrates multispectral optoacoustic tomography (MSOT) and near-infrared region II fluorescence (NIR-II FL) imaging allows complementary deep-tissue visualization with high anatomical resolution and molecular sensitivity, thereby enhancing the accuracy of biomedical diagnostics. Activatable probes further advance this approach by producing signals upon recognition of disease-related biomarkers, which reduces background interference and improves imaging specificity. BTPE-NO 2 @F127, a benzothiadiazole-based nanoprobe, exhibits selective activation of both optoacoustic and NIR-II FL signals in response to hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ), a crucial early stage biomarker of liver injury, thus permitting cross-validated detection of hepatic damage in vivo with excellent signal-to-background ratio contrast. Here we present detailed procedures for preparation of the BTPE-NO 2 @F127 nanoprobe and its applications in MSOT/NIR-II FL dual-mode imaging of trazodone- or ischemia-reperfusion-induced liver injury in mice. Compared to conventional liver injury diagnostic methods, such as invasive tissue biopsy, ex vivo blood analysis and previously reported fluorescent/optoacoustic probes, BTPE-NO 2 @F127 offers real-time, in situ monitoring with high sensitivity and signal-to-background ratio, as well as mutually corroborating signals for increased reliability. The fabrication of BTPE-NO 2 @F127, including the chemical synthesis and characterization, requires ~17 d, while the in vitro validation of its H 2 O 2 responsiveness takes ~5 d. Notably, the complete workflow of data acquisition and analysis for MSOT/NIR-II FL dual-mode imaging of liver injury in mice using BTPE-NO 2 @F127 can be accomplished within 10 h. The protocol is easy to follow and suitable for clinicians and researchers with a basic understanding of chemistry and bioimaging techniques.
items.authors: Wu Y, Zhang C, Chen J, Zeng F, Wu S, Zhao Y, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 可激活的苯并噻二唑纳米探针用于肝损伤双模成像
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于苯并噻二唑的可激活纳米探针BTPE-NO 2 @F127，能够在体内对肝损伤进行多光谱光声成像（MSOT）和近红外区域II荧光成像（NIR-II FL）的双模成像。该探针对氢 peroxide（H 2 O 2）这一肝损伤早期生物标志物具有选择性激活能力，从而实现高信噪比的肝损伤检测。文章详细描述了BTPE-NO 2 @F127的制备过程及其在小鼠中对曲唑酮或缺血-再灌注引起的肝损伤的应用。与传统的肝损伤诊断方法相比，BTPE-NO 2 @F127提供了实时、原位的高灵敏度监测，并且信号相互印证，提高了可靠性。
items.l1_lead: 研究开发的BTPE-NO 2 @F127纳米探针能高效检测肝损伤，提供双模成像技术，显著提高了监测的灵敏度和可靠性。
items.l2_summary:
本文介绍了一种新型的可激活苯并噻二唑纳米探针BTPE-NO2@F127，旨在实现对肝损伤的双模成像，包括多光谱光声成像（MSOT）和近红外区域II荧光成像（NIR-II FL）。该探针具有选择性激活能力，能够针对氢过氧化物（H2O2）这一肝损伤的早期生物标志物进行检测，从而实现高信噪比的肝损伤监测。研究中详细描述了BTPE-NO2@F127的制备过程，并在小鼠模型中应用于曲唑酮或缺血-再灌注引起的肝损伤检测。

与传统的肝损伤诊断方法相比，BTPE-NO2@F127提供了实时、原位的高灵敏度监测，能够有效提高检测的可靠性。该探针在小鼠实验中表现出优越的成像能力，能够清晰地反映肝损伤的程度和范围，且信号之间的相互印证进一步增强了结果的可信度。这项研究为肝损伤的早期诊断提供了一种新的技术手段，具有重要的临床应用潜力。通过这种双模成像技术，研究者能够更准确地评估肝损伤的情况，为后续的治疗方案提供依据。总的来说，BTPE-NO2@F127的开发为肝损伤的检测与监测开辟了新的方向，具有广泛的应用前景。

items.title: Nanotechnology-driven optogenetics for therapeutic grade interventions.
items.body: Optogenetics, a biotechnology that combines optical and genetic strategies to regulate cellular and tissue functions with high spatial and temporal precision, serves as a powerful tool-level regulatory technology widely employed to investigate cellular processes and elucidate disease mechanisms. Nanotechnology-driven optogenetics, which incorporates nanomaterials/nanostructures to improve the efficacy and broaden the applications of optogenetic systems, synergistically integrates the precision, tunability, and multifunctionality of nanotechnology with the spatiotemporal control inherent to optogenetics. The development not only enhances the flexibility and efficiency of optogenetic technology but also advances the field toward therapeutic-grade interventions. In this review, we summarize recent advances in nanotechnology-driven optogenetics, with a particular emphasis on three key areas: (1) nanostructured light sources for the precise activation of optogenetic systems, which include both externally light-stimulated systems and systems that operate independently of external light sources; (2) nanotechnology-enabled targeted delivery of light-sensitive proteins and genetic constructs to ensure efficient modulation of optogenetic pathways, which specifically involves the nanotechnology-assisted gene, protein, and recombinase enzyme delivery approaches; and (3) nanotechnology-driven therapeutic applications of optogenetics, including CAR T cell immunotherapy, cancer treatment, neurological interventions, and cardiac therapies. We further discuss the current challenges facing this emerging field and outline future research directions. This review aims not only to highlight recent breakthroughs but also to position nanotechnology-driven optogenetics as a promising tool for next-generation precision medicine.
items.authors: Chen X, Zhang X, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 纳米技术驱动的光遗传学在治疗干预中的应用
items.summary_zh: 光遗传学是一种结合光学和遗传策略的生物技术，能够以高空间和时间精度调控细胞和组织功能，广泛应用于细胞过程研究和疾病机制阐明。纳米技术驱动的光遗传学通过引入纳米材料/纳米结构，提升了光遗传系统的有效性并拓宽了其应用范围，结合了纳米技术的精确性、可调性和多功能性与光遗传学固有的时空控制。该发展不仅增强了光遗传技术的灵活性和效率，还推动了该领域向治疗级干预的进步。本文总结了纳米技术驱动的光遗传学的最新进展，重点关注三个关键领域：(1) 纳米结构光源用于精确激活光遗传系统，包括外部光刺激系统和独立于外部光源的系统；(2) 纳米技术促进的光敏蛋白和基因构建体的靶向递送，以确保光遗传通路的有效调控；(3) 纳米技术驱动的其他相关应用。
items.l1_lead: 纳米技术驱动的光遗传学通过提升系统有效性和拓宽应用范围，为治疗干预提供了新的可能性，结合了纳米技术的精确性与光遗传学的时空控制。
items.l2_summary:
纳米技术驱动的光遗传学是一种新兴的生物技术，结合了光学和遗传策略，能够以高空间和时间精度调控细胞和组织功能。这一技术在细胞过程研究和疾病机制阐明方面展现了广泛的应用潜力。通过引入纳米材料和纳米结构，纳米技术显著提升了光遗传系统的有效性，并拓宽了其应用范围。这种结合不仅增强了光遗传技术的灵活性和效率，还推动了该领域向治疗级干预的进步。

在纳米技术驱动的光遗传学中，研究者们关注了三个关键领域。首先，纳米结构光源被用于精确激活光遗传系统，包括外部光刺激系统和独立于外部光源的系统。这种精确激活能力使得研究人员能够更好地控制细胞行为，从而深入理解细胞过程和疾病机制。其次，纳米技术促进了光敏蛋白和基因构建体的靶向递送，确保了光遗传通路的有效调控。这一靶向递送机制能够提高光遗传学的应用效率，使得治疗干预更加精准。最后，纳米技术还推动了其他相关应用的发展，进一步拓展了光遗传学在生物医学领域的潜力。

综上所述，纳米技术驱动的光遗传学通过引入纳米材料和纳米结构，提升了光遗传系统的有效性，增强了其灵活性和效率，为治疗干预的进步提供了新的可能性。这一领域的最新进展不仅为基础研究提供了新的工具，也为临床应用开辟了新的方向，预示着未来在疾病治疗和生物医学研究中的广泛应用前景。

items.title: Gut dysbiosis in oncology: a risk factor for immunoresistance.
items.body: The gut microbiome is recognized as a determinant of response to immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapies in cancer. However, the clinical translation of microbiome science has been hampered by inconsistent definitions of dysbiosis, inadequate biomarker frameworks, and limited mechanistic understanding. In this review, we synthesize the current state of knowledge on how gut microbial composition and function influence ICI efficacy, highlighting both correlative and causal evidence. We discuss computational approaches based on α-diversity or taxonomic abundance and argue for more functionally and clinically informative models, such as the topological score (TOPOSCORE) and other dysbiosis indices derived from machine learning. Using retrospective analyses of metagenomic datasets from thousands of patients and healthy controls, we examine microbial patterns that distinguish responders from non-responders. We also explore how dysbiosis perturbs immunoregulatory pathways, including bile acid metabolism, gut permeability, and mucosal immunomodulation. Finally, we assess emerging therapeutic strategies aimed at correcting microbiome dysfunction - including dietary modification, bacterial consortia, and fecal microbiota transplantation - and describe how they are being deployed in multiple clinical trials. We conclude with a brief discussion of the ONCOBIOME initiative, which works with international partners to incorporate microbiome science into oncology workflows. By refining our understanding of gut-immune interactions and translating it into action, microbiome-informed oncology may unlock new therapeutic potential for patients previously resistant to immunotherapy.
items.authors: Almonte AA, Thomas S, Iebba V, Kroemer G, Derosa L, Zitvogel L.
items.title_zh: 肠道微生物失调与肿瘤免疫耐受的风险因素
items.summary_zh: 肠道微生物组被认为是癌症免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗法反应的决定因素。然而，微生物组科学的临床转化受到失调（dysbiosis）定义不一致、标志物框架不足和机制理解有限的阻碍。本文综述了肠道微生物组成和功能如何影响ICI疗效的现状，强调了相关和因果证据。我们讨论了基于α多样性或分类丰度的计算方法，并主张采用更具功能性和临床信息的模型，如拓扑评分（TOPOSCORE）和其他基于机器学习的失调指数。通过对数千名患者和健康对照的宏基因组数据集进行回顾性分析，我们考察了区分应答者与非应答者的微生物模式。同时，探讨了失调如何扰乱免疫调节通路，包括胆汁酸代谢、肠道通透性和粘膜免疫调节。最后，我们评估了旨在纠正微生物组功能障碍的新兴治疗策略，包括饮食调整、细菌组合和粪便微生物移植，并描述了它们在多个临床试验中的应用。我们最后简要讨论了ONCOBIOME倡议。
items.l1_lead: 肠道微生物失调影响癌症免疫检查点抑制剂疗效，需采用更具功能性的模型评估其对免疫调节的影响，并探索新兴治疗策略以纠正微生物组功能障碍。
items.l2_summary:
肠道微生物组在癌症免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗法的反应中扮演着重要角色，但其临床转化受到微生物失调（dysbiosis）定义不一致、标志物框架不足以及机制理解有限等因素的制约。本文综述了肠道微生物的组成和功能如何影响ICI疗效，强调了相关和因果证据。研究表明，微生物组的α多样性和分类丰度的计算方法存在局限，因此建议采用更具功能性和临床信息的模型，如拓扑评分（TOPOSCORE）和其他基于机器学习的失调指数，以更准确地评估微生物组的状态。

通过对数千名患者和健康对照的宏基因组数据集进行回顾性分析，研究者考察了能够区分应答者与非应答者的微生物模式。这些分析揭示了微生物失调如何扰乱免疫调节通路，包括胆汁酸代谢、肠道通透性和粘膜免疫调节等关键机制。这些失调不仅影响了肠道的微生物组成，还可能导致肿瘤免疫耐受的风险增加。

此外，本文还评估了旨在纠正微生物组功能障碍的新兴治疗策略，包括饮食调整、细菌组合和粪便微生物移植等。这些策略在多个临床试验中得到了应用，显示出一定的潜力。最后，研究者简要讨论了ONCOBIOME倡议，强调了在癌症治疗中整合微生物组研究的重要性。通过深入理解肠道微生物组与肿瘤免疫之间的关系，未来有望开发出更有效的治疗方案，以提高ICI疗法的疗效。

items.title: Nanomedicine-Based Therapeutic Strategies for Next-Generation Cancer Immunotherapy.
items.body: Cancer immunotherapy has reshaped cancer treatment by enabling the immune system to recognize and eliminate tumor cells. Nevertheless, its clinical translation remains limited by suboptimal response rates, poor penetration into deep tumor tissues, and insufficient therapeutic efficacy. Cancer immunotherapy alone is often inadequate as a sole treatment modality. Nanomedicine-based therapeutic strategies, including photothermal therapy, photodynamic therapy, sonodynamic therapy, nanozyme-based therapy, and cancer vaccines, have achieved considerable recognition for cancer treatment. Upon integration with cancer immunotherapy or regulated cell death pathways, these nanomedicine-based therapeutic strategies can modulate the tumor microenvironment, enhance anticancer immune response, and overcome immunotherapy resistance. This article summarizes recent advances in nanomedicine-based therapeutic strategies, the role of cancer immunotherapy, and regulated cell death pathways. We outline the strengths and limitations of these therapeutic strategies. We also discuss how combination therapeutic strategies achieve synergistic effects, future challenges, and perspectives in developing next-generation nanomedicine platforms for cancer immunotherapy.
items.authors: Tan BSN, Zhao Y, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 基于纳米医学的下一代癌症免疫治疗策略
items.summary_zh: 癌症免疫治疗通过激活免疫系统识别和消灭肿瘤细胞，重新定义了癌症治疗。然而，其临床应用受到反应率低、深层肿瘤组织渗透性差和治疗效果不足的限制，单独使用免疫治疗往往不够有效。基于纳米医学的治疗策略，如光热疗法、光动力疗法、声动力疗法、纳米酶治疗和癌症疫苗，已在癌症治疗中获得显著认可。与癌症免疫治疗或调控细胞死亡途径结合，这些策略能够调节肿瘤微环境，增强抗癌免疫反应，并克服免疫治疗的耐药性。本文总结了基于纳米医学的治疗策略的最新进展、癌症免疫治疗的作用及调控细胞死亡途径，分析了这些策略的优缺点，并探讨了组合治疗策略如何实现协同效应、未来挑战及开发下一代纳米医学平台的前景。
items.l1_lead: 基于纳米医学的癌症免疫治疗策略通过结合多种治疗方法，能够有效增强抗癌免疫反应，克服传统免疫治疗的局限性，展现出良好的应用前景。
items.l2_summary:
癌症免疫治疗通过激活免疫系统来识别和消灭肿瘤细胞，已重新定义了癌症治疗的方式。然而，当前的临床应用面临着反应率低、深层肿瘤组织渗透性差以及治疗效果不足等限制，单独使用免疫治疗往往效果不佳。为了解决这些问题，基于纳米医学的治疗策略逐渐受到重视，包括光热疗法、光动力疗法、声动力疗法、纳米酶治疗和癌症疫苗等。这些策略在癌症治疗中取得了显著的认可，尤其是当它们与癌症免疫治疗或调控细胞死亡途径相结合时，能够有效调节肿瘤微环境，增强抗癌免疫反应，并克服免疫治疗的耐药性。

在最新的研究中，基于纳米医学的治疗策略展现出良好的前景。通过这些策略，研究者们能够改善免疫治疗的效果，提升肿瘤细胞的识别率和消灭率。具体而言，光热疗法和光动力疗法通过局部加热或光照，能够直接杀死肿瘤细胞，同时激活免疫系统的反应；声动力疗法则利用声波增强药物的渗透性，提升治疗效果；纳米酶治疗通过模拟酶的功能，促进肿瘤微环境的改变，从而增强免疫反应；癌症疫苗则通过激发特异性免疫反应，进一步提高治疗的有效性。

然而，这些策略也存在一定的局限性，例如可能导致的副作用、治疗成本以及在临床应用中的复杂性。因此，研究者们正在探索组合治疗策略，以实现不同治疗方法之间的协同效应。这种组合不仅可以提高疗效，还能降低耐药性带来的影响。未来的挑战在于如何优化这些纳米医学平台，以便在临床上实现更广泛的应用。

总的来说，基于纳米医学的下一代癌症免疫治疗策略展现出巨大的潜力，能够为癌症患者提供更有效的治疗选择。随着研究的深入和技术的进步，未来有望开发出更为先进的纳米医学平台，以应对癌症治疗中的各种挑战。

items.title: Engineering Heterocyclic Linkages to Expand the Structural and Functional Diversity of Covalent Organic Frameworks.
items.body: Heterocycle-linked covalent organic frameworks (HC-COFs) are a promising class of crystalline porous polymers constructed by linking organic modules into extended structures via heterocyclic moieties. HC-COFs have received considerable attention due to their robust linkages, extended π-conjugation and abundant heteroatomic sites. These intrinsic characteristics endow HC-COFs with high chemical stability, enhanced light-harvesting ability, and tunable redox activity, thus making them promising systems for widespread applications such as separation, catalysis, sensing, luminescence, biomedicine, energy storage, and environmental remediation. This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of de novo synthesis and post-synthetic modification strategies employed for the production of HC-COFs, along with their physicochemical properties and representative applications. Finally, we highlight the future opportunities and challenges of HC-COFs for next generation functional materials. This review would offer an insightful understanding of the subtle interplay between heterocyclic linkages and overall skeleton, thus providing a useful guidance on how to further solve the COF trilemma regarding crystallinity, stability and functionality.
items.authors: Qian C, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 异环链接共价有机框架的结构与功能多样性扩展
items.summary_zh: 异环链接共价有机框架（HC-COFs）是一类通过异环基团将有机模块连接成扩展结构的结晶多孔聚合物。由于其稳健的链接、扩展的π-共轭以及丰富的杂原子位点，HC-COFs引起了广泛关注。这些内在特性赋予HC-COFs高化学稳定性、增强的光捕获能力和可调的氧化还原活性，使其在分离、催化、传感、发光、生物医学、能源存储和环境修复等广泛应用中展现出良好前景。本文综述了HC-COFs的从头合成与后合成修饰策略，以及其物理化学性质和代表性应用。最后，我们强调了HC-COFs在下一代功能材料中的未来机遇与挑战，为理解异环链接与整体骨架之间的微妙相互作用提供了深入见解，并为解决COF在结晶性、稳定性和功能性方面的三难问题提供了有益指导。
items.l1_lead: 异环链接共价有机框架（HC-COFs）因其优异的化学稳定性和多样化功能，展现出在多个领域的广泛应用潜力，并为未来材料研究提供了重要指导。
items.l2_summary:
异环链接共价有机框架（HC-COFs）是一种通过异环基团将有机模块连接而成的结晶多孔聚合物，因其独特的结构和优异的性能而备受关注。HC-COFs具备稳健的链接特性、扩展的π-共轭体系以及丰富的杂原子位点，这些内在特性使其在化学稳定性、光捕获能力和氧化还原活性等方面表现出色。这些优点使HC-COFs在分离、催化、传感、发光、生物医学、能源存储和环境修复等多个领域展现出广泛的应用前景。

本文综述了HC-COFs的从头合成与后合成修饰策略，探讨了其物理化学性质及代表性应用。通过系统的合成方法，研究者能够调控HC-COFs的结构和功能，进而优化其性能。此外，HC-COFs的多样性使其在不同应用场景中展现出独特的优势，例如在催化反应中能够提高反应效率，在传感器中能够实现高灵敏度的检测。

然而，HC-COFs在结晶性、稳定性和功能性方面仍面临三难问题。本文强调了理解异环链接与整体骨架之间微妙相互作用的重要性，这为未来的研究提供了新的视角和方向。通过深入探讨这些相互作用，研究者可以更好地解决HC-COFs在实际应用中遇到的挑战，推动其在下一代功能材料中的发展。

总的来说，HC-COFs作为一种新兴材料，凭借其独特的结构和优异的性能，展现出广阔的应用前景和研究价值。未来的研究将继续探索其合成与功能调控的策略，以期在更广泛的领域中实现应用。

items.title: Navigating the next frontier in biomedicine: breakthroughs and insights in nucleic acid therapeutics.
items.body: Nucleic acid therapeutics are rapidly emerging as a transformative drug paradigm, offering precise and programmable regulation of gene expression across a broad spectrum of diseases. This review summarizes recent advances in key platforms-including antisense oligonucleotides, siRNA, miRNA, mRNA, and aptamers-emphasizing their unique mechanisms of action and therapeutic potential. We systematically outline critical contributions of chemical modification and delivery engineering, including backbone and sugar modifications, site-specific design, N -acetylgalactosamine (GalNAc) conjugation, and lipid nanoparticles, which collectively enhance stability, target specificity, and clinical applicability. Finally, we discuss persistent challenges such as immune activation, large-scale manufacturing, and long-term safety, and provide perspectives on future directions involving CRISPR-based gene editing, synthetic biology, nanotechnology, smart delivery systems, and combination therapies, aiming to offer strategic insights for the development and clinical translation of nucleic acid drugs.
items.authors: Wu S, Zhang Z, Zhao Z, Cui C, Tan W.
items.title_zh: 生物医学新前沿：核酸治疗的突破与见解
items.summary_zh: 核酸治疗作为一种变革性的药物范式，正在迅速崛起，能够在广泛疾病中精确调控基因表达。本文综述了抗病毒寡核苷酸（antisense oligonucleotides）、小干扰RNA（siRNA）、微RNA（miRNA）、信使RNA（mRNA）和适配体（aptamers）等关键平台的最新进展，强调其独特的作用机制和治疗潜力。我们系统性地概述了化学修饰和递送工程的关键贡献，包括骨架和糖的修饰、特定位点设计、N-乙酰半乳糖胺（GalNAc）结合以及脂质纳米颗粒，这些措施共同提高了稳定性、靶向特异性和临床适用性。最后，我们讨论了免疫激活、大规模生产和长期安全性等持续挑战，并展望了未来的方向，包括基于CRISPR的基因编辑、合成生物学、纳米技术、智能递送系统和组合疗法，为核酸药物的开发和临床转化提供战略见解。
items.l1_lead: 核酸治疗正迅速崛起，具备精确调控基因表达的潜力，关键平台的最新进展和技术创新为其临床应用提供了新的战略方向。
items.l2_summary:
核酸治疗作为一种新兴的药物开发模式，正在迅速发展，具有在多种疾病中精确调控基因表达的潜力。本文综述了几种关键的核酸治疗平台，包括抗病毒寡核苷酸（antisense oligonucleotides）、小干扰RNA（siRNA）、微RNA（miRNA）、信使RNA（mRNA）和适配体（aptamers），并强调了它们各自独特的作用机制和治疗前景。通过对这些平台的最新进展进行系统性分析，研究指出化学修饰和递送工程在提高核酸药物的稳定性、靶向特异性和临床适用性方面发挥了重要作用。例如，骨架和糖的修饰、特定位点设计、N-乙酰半乳糖胺（GalNAc）结合以及脂质纳米颗粒的应用，均显著增强了核酸药物的效果。

然而，尽管核酸治疗展现出巨大的潜力，仍面临一些挑战，包括免疫激活、大规模生产的可行性和长期安全性等问题。针对这些挑战，本文展望了未来的发展方向，提出基于CRISPR的基因编辑技术、合成生物学、纳米技术、智能递送系统以及组合疗法等新兴策略，可能为核酸药物的开发和临床转化提供新的思路和解决方案。这些前沿技术的结合有望推动核酸治疗的进一步应用，改善患者的治疗效果，最终实现个性化医疗的目标。通过对这些关键领域的深入研究，科学家们正在为核酸治疗的未来铺平道路，期待其在临床实践中的广泛应用。

items.title: Organic Phosphorescence from Functional Polymer Matrices.
items.body: Research on organic phosphorescence shows great promise, while classical small-molecule phosphorescence systems often face challenges in terms of cost, scalability, and functionalization. Polymer matrices provide powerful and versatile platforms for fabricating advanced functional organic phosphorescent materials. The unique microenvironment within dense polymer networks effectively stabilizes the generated triplet excitons, and the inherent diversity of polymers allows for broad functional integration. This perspective summarizes key construction strategies of polymer matrix-supported organic phosphorescent materials and highlights how these systems enable useful functions, including tunable luminescence, stimulus responsiveness, mechanical flexibility, water solubility, and potential biocompatibility, for targeted applications. Finally, we discuss critical challenges and future directions for further advancement of this rapidly growing field.

items.title_zh: 功能聚合物基质中的有机磷光现象研究
items.summary_zh: 有机磷光（phosphorescence）研究展现出巨大潜力，但传统小分子磷光系统在成本、可扩展性和功能化方面面临挑战。聚合物基质提供了强大而多功能的平台，用于制造先进的有机磷光材料。密集聚合物网络中的独特微环境有效稳定了生成的三重态激子（triplet excitons），而聚合物的多样性则允许广泛的功能整合。本文总结了聚合物基质支持的有机磷光材料的关键构建策略，并强调这些系统如何实现可调光（tunable luminescence）、刺激响应（stimulus responsiveness）、机械柔韧性、水溶性和潜在的生物相容性（biocompatibility）等有用功能，以满足特定应用需求。最后，讨论了该快速发展的领域面临的关键挑战和未来发展方向。
items.l1_lead: 聚合物基质为有机磷光材料提供了稳定的微环境和多功能性，克服了传统小分子系统的局限，展现出广泛的应用潜力。
items.l2_summary:
有机磷光（phosphorescence）研究近年来展现出巨大的潜力，但传统的小分子磷光系统在成本、可扩展性和功能化方面面临诸多挑战。聚合物基质作为一种强大而多功能的平台，为制造先进的有机磷光材料提供了新的机遇。聚合物的密集网络能够有效稳定生成的三重态激子（triplet excitons），从而提升磷光性能。此外，聚合物的多样性使得功能整合成为可能，能够满足不同应用的需求。

本文总结了聚合物基质支持的有机磷光材料的关键构建策略，强调了这些系统在可调光（tunable luminescence）、刺激响应（stimulus responsiveness）、机械柔韧性、水溶性和潜在的生物相容性（biocompatibility）等方面的有用功能。这些特性使得聚合物基质中的有机磷光材料在实际应用中具有广泛的前景。例如，通过调节聚合物的组成和结构，可以实现对磷光发射波长的精确控制，从而满足特定的光学需求。

然而，该领域在快速发展的同时也面临着一些关键挑战，包括如何进一步提高磷光效率、增强材料的稳定性以及实现大规模生产等。未来的发展方向可能集中在优化聚合物的合成方法、探索新型聚合物材料以及开发更为高效的磷光机制等方面。通过克服这些挑战，有望推动有机磷光材料在光电子学、生物成像和显示技术等领域的广泛应用。

items.title: Comparison between accelerated and standard or sham rTMS in the treatment of depression: A systematic review.
items.body: Major depressive disorder (MDD) represents a major global health challenge, with a significant proportion of patients being resistant to drug treatment (TRD). Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has shown promise in the treatment of MDD/TRD, with a single stimulation session per day for five days per week over several weeks (the "standard" protocol). The two main paradigms used are high-frequency rTMS and intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) delivered to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Accelerated TMS (aTMS) protocols aim to make the treatment more effective, or at least more rapidly effective, by delivering more stimulations in a shorter time, which could also facilitate the implementation of the protocols for a larger number of patients. In this systematic literature review, articles comparing in the same study an aTMS protocol to a standard or sham rTMS protocol were retained for analysis. Thus, 23 articles were retained and the analysis focused on the efficacy of aTMS protocols used for the treatment of depression (MDD/TRD) as well as on the impact of various stimulation parameters, such as stimulation pattern, intersession interval, dosage, and methods of cortical targeting. Although some studies did not report significant differences between aTMS and standard or sham protocols, others suggested potential advantages of aTMS, such as twice-daily HF-rTMS of the left DLPFC or more intensive iTBS protocols with a long interval between two sessions and personalized cortical targeting. Our results highlight the influence of the number of sessions or pulses per session (dosage), the duration of the interval between sessions, and the precision of target localization (using image-guided neuronavigation) on therapeutic efficacy. However, limitations in sample size, few independent studies replicating the same methodology, and variability in the clinical profile of treated patients, given different definitions of treatment resistance or the presence of comorbidities, hamper definitive conclusions.

items.title_zh: 加速与标准或假刺激rTMS治疗抑郁症的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 重度抑郁障碍（MDD）是全球健康的重要挑战，部分患者对药物治疗抵抗（TRD）。重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）在MDD/TRD治疗中显示出潜力，标准方案为每周五天每天一次的刺激。主要使用的两种模式为高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS），作用于左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）。加速TMS（aTMS）方案旨在通过在更短时间内提供更多刺激，提高治疗效果或加快效果实现，从而使更多患者受益。本系统文献综述分析了比较aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS的23篇文章，重点关注aTMS在抑郁症（MDD/TRD）治疗中的有效性及刺激参数的影响，如刺激模式、间歇间隔、剂量和皮层靶向方法。尽管部分研究未发现aTMS与标准或假刺激方案之间的显著差异，但其他研究则提出了aTMS的潜在优势。
items.l1_lead: 加速TMS（aTMS）在治疗重度抑郁障碍中显示出潜在优势，尽管部分研究未发现其与标准或假刺激方案的显著差异。
items.l2_summary:
重度抑郁障碍（MDD）是全球健康面临的重要挑战，尤其是部分患者对药物治疗产生抵抗（TRD）。重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）作为一种新兴的治疗手段，在MDD和TRD的治疗中展现出良好的潜力。标准的rTMS治疗方案通常为每周五天、每天一次，主要采用高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS）两种模式，针对左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）进行刺激。为了提高治疗效果或加快效果实现，加速TMS（aTMS）方案应运而生，旨在通过在更短的时间内提供更多的刺激，使更多患者能够受益。

本系统文献综述分析了23篇研究，比较了aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS的有效性，重点关注刺激参数对治疗效果的影响，包括刺激模式、间歇间隔、剂量和皮层靶向方法。尽管部分研究未能发现aTMS与标准或假刺激方案之间存在显著差异，但也有研究提出了aTMS的潜在优势，暗示其在某些情况下可能更有效。总体而言，尽管目前的证据尚不完全一致，但aTMS作为一种新兴的治疗方式，仍然值得进一步探索，以期为更多抑郁症患者提供更有效的治疗选择。

items.title: Executive functioning in adolescents with internalizing disorders: a systematic review.
items.body: Internalizing disorders (INTs), including anxiety (AD) and depressive disorders (DD), frequently emerge during adolescence. Studies suggest that certain core domains of executive functioning (EF), i.e. inhibition, shifting and working memory (WM) may show selectively lower performance in certain INTs. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the evidence of associations between INTs and EF in adolescents. A systematic search was conducted in Medline, Psych-INFO, Scopus, and Web of Science in May 2023. Inclusion focused on adolescents (12-17) with AD (including obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)) or DD. After screening 2,551 titles/abstracts, 818 records underwent full-text review, on which independent reviewers reached 93% agreement on eligibility. EF parameters, measured through task-performance or ratings, were extracted from 32 eligible articles published since 2014. Performance-based EF differences were reported in 22 studies, most frequently in adolescents with DD. Task-based inhibition showed lower scores most consistently in DD (n = 5). Findings were mixed across other INTs. Three studies found evidence for improved inhibition performance in OCD (n = 2) and AD (n = 1). Finally, 6 studies reporting on self- or parent-rated EF found significant difficulties across EF domains, of which 3 contrasted with intact performances on task-based measurements of EF. Findings suggest both objective and subjective EF difficulties across INTs with no conclusive evidence for selective domain-specific differences. We highlight a discrepancy between subjectively experienced or observed deficits in daily EF and performance on structured tasks. This suggests that rating-based EF may be more sensitive for capturing subtle EF difficulties and therefore adds value in research and clinical settings. Finally, the quality of studies is discussed and directions for future studies are identified, namely, the use of both task and rating-based measures of EF as well as inclusion of larger sample sizes.
items.authors: Fontaine GP, Blake KV, Koen N, Stein DJ, Hammar Å, Groenewold NA.
items.title_zh: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能的系统评估
items.summary_zh: 内化障碍（INTs），包括焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD），在青少年中常见。本系统评估旨在探讨青少年内化障碍与执行功能（EF）之间的关联。研究通过对2014年以来的32篇符合条件的文章进行分析，发现执行功能的核心领域，如抑制、转换和工作记忆，在某些内化障碍中表现出选择性较低的表现。22项研究报告了基于表现的执行功能差异，尤其是在抑郁障碍青少年中最为明显。抑制任务的得分在抑郁障碍中最为一致地较低（n = 5）。其他内化障碍的结果则较为混杂。有三项研究发现强迫症（OCD）和焦虑障碍的抑制表现有所改善。最后，6项关于自评或父母评估的研究显示在执行功能各领域存在显著困难，其中3项与任务表现良好相对立。
items.l1_lead: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能存在显著关联，尤其抑郁障碍青少年在抑制、转换和工作记忆等核心领域表现较差。
items.l2_summary:
青少年内化障碍（INTs），如焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD），在青少年群体中普遍存在。本研究通过系统评估自2014年以来的32篇相关文献，旨在探讨青少年内化障碍与执行功能（EF）之间的关系。研究发现，执行功能的核心领域，包括抑制、转换和工作记忆，在某些内化障碍中表现出选择性较低的表现。具体而言，22项研究报告了基于表现的执行功能差异，尤其是在抑郁障碍青少年中，这种差异最为显著。抑制任务的得分在抑郁障碍群体中表现出一致性较低的趋势，5项研究均表明抑郁障碍青少年在此方面的表现较差。

此外，其他内化障碍的研究结果则较为复杂，部分研究显示强迫症（OCD）和焦虑障碍的抑制表现有所改善，表明不同类型的内化障碍在执行功能的影响上可能存在差异。值得注意的是，6项关于自评或父母评估的研究显示，在执行功能的各个领域中，青少年普遍存在显著困难，其中有3项研究的结果与任务表现良好的情况相对立。这些发现表明，青少年内化障碍与执行功能之间存在复杂的相互关系，尤其是抑郁障碍对执行功能的影响更为明显，提示在临床干预中应重视执行功能的评估与训练，以改善青少年的心理健康状况。

items.title: A whole-brain voxel-based analysis of structural abnormalities in PTSD: An ENIGMA-PGC study.
items.body: Background Patients with posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) exhibit smaller regional brain volumes in commonly reported regions including the amygdala and hippocampus, regions associated with fear and memory processing. In the current study, we have conducted a voxel-based morphometry (VBM) meta-analysis using whole-brain statistical maps with neuroimaging data from the ENIGMA-PGC PTSD working group. Methods T1-weighted structural neuroimaging scans from 36 cohorts (PTSD n = 1309; controls n = 2198) were processed using a standardized VBM pipeline (ENIGMA-VBM tool). We meta-analyzed the resulting statistical maps for voxel-wise differences in gray matter (GM) and white matter (WM) volumes between PTSD patients and controls, performed subgroup analyses considering the trauma exposure of the controls, and examined associations between regional brain volumes and clinical variables including PTSD (CAPS-4/5, PCL-5) and depression severity (BDI-II, PHQ-9). Results PTSD patients exhibited smaller GM volumes across the frontal and temporal lobes, and cerebellum, with the most significant effect in the left cerebellum (Hedges' g = 0.22, p corrected = .001), and smaller cerebellar WM volume (peak Hedges' g = 0.14, p corrected = .008). We observed similar regional differences when comparing patients to trauma-exposed controls, suggesting these structural abnormalities may be specific to PTSD. Regression analyses revealed PTSD severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum ( p corrected = .003), while depression severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum and superior frontal gyrus in patients ( p corrected = .001). Conclusions PTSD patients exhibited widespread, regional differences in brain volumes where greater regional deficits appeared to reflect more severe symptoms. Our findings add to the growing literature implicating the cerebellum in PTSD psychopathology.

items.title_zh: PTSD患者脑结构异常的整体脑体素分析：ENIGMA-PGC研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了整体脑体素（voxel-based）分析。研究发现，PTSD患者在前额叶、颞叶和小脑等区域的灰质（gray matter, GM）体积较小，尤其在左小脑的影响最为显著（Hedges' g = 0.22, p校正 = .001），同时小脑的白质（white matter, WM）体积也较小（峰值Hedges' g = 0.14, p校正 = .008）。通过与经历过创伤的对照组进行比较，结果显示这些结构异常可能特定于PTSD患者。研究使用了来自36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像扫描数据，分析了PTSD患者与对照组在灰质和白质体积上的差异，并探讨了区域脑体积与临床变量（如PTSD和抑郁严重程度）之间的关联。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者在前额叶、颞叶和小脑等区域的灰质和白质体积显著减少，提示这些结构异常可能特定于PTSD。
items.l2_summary:
本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了整体脑体素（voxel-based）分析，旨在揭示PTSD患者在脑部结构上的特征性变化。研究结果显示，PTSD患者在前额叶、颞叶和小脑等关键区域的灰质（gray matter, GM）体积显著较小，尤其是在左小脑的变化最为明显，Hedges' g值为0.22，校正后的p值为0.001。此外，小脑的白质（white matter, WM）体积同样较小，峰值Hedges' g为0.14，校正后的p值为0.008。这些发现表明，PTSD患者的脑结构异常可能具有特异性，与经历过创伤的对照组相比，PTSD患者在灰质和白质体积上的差异更加明显。

本研究使用了来自36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像扫描数据，系统分析了PTSD患者与对照组在脑部结构上的差异，并探讨了区域脑体积与临床变量之间的关联，特别是PTSD和抑郁严重程度。通过这些分析，研究进一步支持了PTSD患者在脑结构上的特征性变化，强调了小脑在PTSD中的重要性。这些结果为理解PTSD的神经生物学基础提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的干预和治疗策略提供依据。

items.title: The meltdown pathway: A multidisciplinary account of autistic meltdowns.
items.body: Autistic meltdowns are fits of intense frustration and often physical violence elicited by sensory and cognitive stressors. Despite the high prevalence of meltdowns among autistic individuals, the neural mechanisms that underlie this response are not yet well understood. This has thus far hampered progress toward a dedicated therapeutic intervention-beyond traditional medications-that limits their frequency and severity. Here, we aim to initiate an interdisciplinary dialogue on the etiology of sensory meltdowns. In doing so, we frame meltdowns as a consequence of underlying chronic hypervigilance and acute hyperreactivity to objectively benign stressors driven by differences in the insular cortex-a multimodal integration hub that adapts autonomic state and behavior to meet environmental demands. We first discuss meltdowns through the lens of neurophysiology and argue that intrainsular hypoconnectivity engenders vagal withdrawal and sympathetic hyperarousal in autism, driving chronic hypervigilance and reducing the threshold of stressors those with autism can tolerate before experiencing a meltdown. Next, we turn to neuropsychology and present evidence that meltdowns reflect a difference in how contextual evidence, particularly social cues, is integrated when acutely assessing ambiguous signs of danger in the environment-a process termed neuroception. Finally, we build on contemporary predictive coding accounts of autism to argue that meltdowns may be ultimately driven by differences in sensory attenuation and coherent deep inference within the interoceptive hierarchy, possibly linked to oxytocin deficiency during infancy. Throughout, we synthesize each perspective to construct a multidisciplinary, insula-based model of meltdowns. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2025 APA, all rights reserved).
items.authors: Soden PA, Bhat A, Anderson AK, Friston K.
items.title_zh: 自闭症情绪崩溃的多学科探讨
items.summary_zh: 自闭症情绪崩溃是由感官和认知压力引发的强烈挫败感和身体暴力表现。尽管自闭症个体中情绪崩溃的发生率很高，但其神经机制尚不清楚，阻碍了针对性治疗的进展。本文旨在启动关于感官崩溃病因的跨学科对话，认为情绪崩溃是由于慢性过度警觉和对客观无害压力源的急性过度反应所致，这与岛叶皮层（insular cortex）的差异有关。我们首先从神经生理学的角度讨论情绪崩溃，认为岛叶内连接不足导致自闭症患者的迷走神经抑制和交感神经兴奋，进而驱动慢性过度警觉，降低可承受压力源的阈值。接着，从神经心理学的角度提供证据，表明情绪崩溃反映了在评估环境中模糊危险信号时，特别是社交线索的整合差异，称为神经感知（neuroception）。
items.l1_lead: 自闭症情绪崩溃源于感官和认知压力引发的过度反应，涉及岛叶皮层的神经机制差异，需跨学科探讨以推动治疗进展。
items.l2_summary:
自闭症情绪崩溃是一种由感官和认知压力引发的强烈挫败感，常表现为身体暴力行为。尽管在自闭症个体中，情绪崩溃的发生率较高，但其神经机制仍不明确，这限制了针对性治疗的进展。本文旨在启动关于感官崩溃病因的跨学科对话，提出情绪崩溃源于慢性过度警觉和对客观无害压力源的急性过度反应，这与岛叶皮层（insular cortex）的差异密切相关。

从神经生理学的角度来看，情绪崩溃的发生与岛叶内连接不足有关，这种不足导致自闭症患者的迷走神经抑制和交感神经兴奋，进而引发慢性过度警觉，降低了个体对压力源的承受阈值。这种神经机制的变化使得自闭症患者在面对常规环境时，容易产生强烈的情绪反应。

此外，从神经心理学的角度，情绪崩溃还反映了在评估环境中模糊危险信号时，尤其是在社交线索的整合上存在差异，这一现象被称为神经感知（neuroception）。这种整合差异使得自闭症个体在面对社交情境时，无法准确判断潜在的威胁，从而导致情绪崩溃的发生。

综上所述，情绪崩溃的多学科探讨揭示了自闭症患者在感官和认知处理上的独特挑战，强调了岛叶皮层在情绪调节中的重要性。这一研究为理解自闭症情绪崩溃的机制提供了新的视角，并为未来的干预策略奠定了基础。通过深入探讨这些神经生理和神经心理机制，能够更好地为自闭症患者提供针对性的支持和治疗。

items.title: Active inference and cognitive control: Balancing deliberation and habits through precision optimization.
items.body: We advance a novel formulation of cognitive control within the active inference framework. The theory proposes that cognitive control amounts to optimising a precision parameter, which acts as a control signal and balances the contributions of deliberative and habitual components of action selection. To illustrate the theory, we simulate a driving scenario in which the driver follows a well-known route, but encounters unexpected challenges. Our simulations show that a standard active inference model can form adaptive habits; i.e., can pass from deliberative to habitual control when the context is stable, but generally fails to revert to deliberative control, when the context changes. To address this failure of context-sensitivity, we introduce a novel type of hierarchical active inference, in which a lower level is responsible for behavioural control and the higher (or meta-cognitive) level observes the belief updating of the lower level below and is responsible for cognitive control. Crucially, the meta-cognitive level can both form habits and suspend them, by controlling the (precision) parameter that prioritizes deliberative choices at the behavioural level. Furthermore, we show that several processes linked to cognitive control - such as surprise detection, cognitive conflict monitoring, control signal regulation and specification, the simulation of future outcomes and the assessment of the costs of control and mental effort - stem coherently from the free energy minimization scheme that underpins active inference. Finally, we discuss the putative neurobiology of cognitive control by simulating brain dynamics in the mesolimbic and mesocortical pathways of the dopamine system, the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex and the locus coeruleus.
items.authors: Proietti R, Parr T, Tessari A, Friston K, Pezzulo G.
items.title_zh: 主动推理与认知控制：通过精度优化平衡深思与习惯
items.summary_zh: 本文在主动推理（active inference）框架内提出了一种新的认知控制理论。该理论认为，认知控制是优化一个精度参数的过程，该参数作为控制信号，平衡深思（deliberative）与习惯（habitual）在行动选择中的贡献。通过模拟驾驶场景，研究表明标准的主动推理模型能够形成适应性习惯，即在环境稳定时可以从深思转向习惯控制，但在环境变化时通常无法恢复到深思控制。为了解决这一上下文敏感性缺失的问题，本文引入了一种新型的层级主动推理，其中低层负责行为控制，高层（或元认知层）观察低层的信念更新并负责认知控制。关键在于，元认知层能够形成和暂停习惯，通过控制优先考虑深思选择的精度参数。此外，本文还展示了与认知控制相关的多个过程，如惊讶检测、认知冲突监测、控制信号调节与规范、未来结果的模拟等。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种新型的认知控制理论，通过优化精度参数，平衡深思与习惯的贡献，以应对环境变化带来的挑战。
items.l2_summary:
本文在主动推理（active inference）框架内提出了一种新的认知控制理论，认为认知控制是一个优化精度参数的过程，该参数作为控制信号，旨在平衡深思（deliberative）与习惯（habitual）在行动选择中的贡献。研究通过模拟驾驶场景，表明标准的主动推理模型能够形成适应性习惯，即在环境稳定时能够从深思转向习惯控制。然而，当环境发生变化时，模型通常无法恢复到深思控制的状态，这揭示了上下文敏感性缺失的问题。

为了解决这一问题，本文引入了一种新型的层级主动推理模型，其中低层负责具体的行为控制，而高层（或元认知层）则观察低层的信念更新并负责认知控制。元认知层的关键功能在于能够形成和暂停习惯，通过调节精度参数来优先考虑深思选择。这种机制使得在面对变化的环境时，个体能够更灵活地调整其认知策略，从而提高适应性。

此外，本文还探讨了与认知控制相关的多个过程，包括惊讶检测、认知冲突监测、控制信号的调节与规范，以及未来结果的模拟等。这些过程共同作用，增强了个体在复杂环境中的决策能力，促进了深思与习惯之间的有效平衡。通过这一理论框架，研究为理解认知控制提供了新的视角，强调了在不同情境下优化精度参数的重要性，从而为未来的研究和应用奠定了基础。

items.title: Consortium profile: the methylation, imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) consortium.
items.body: Epigenetic processes, such as DNA methylation, show potential as biological markers and mechanisms underlying gene-environment interplay in the prediction of mental health and other brain-based phenotypes. However, little is known about how peripheral epigenetic patterns relate to individual differences in the brain itself. An increasingly popular approach to address this is by combining epigenetic and neuroimaging data; yet, research in this area is almost entirely comprised of cross-sectional studies in adults. To bridge this gap, we established the Methylation, Imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) Consortium, which aims to bring a developmental focus to the emerging field of Neuroimaging Epigenetics by (i) promoting collaborative, adequately powered developmental research via multi-cohort analyses; (ii) increasing scientific rigor through the establishment of shared pipelines and open science practices; and (iii) advancing our understanding of DNA methylation-brain dynamics at different developmental periods (from birth to emerging adulthood), by leveraging data from prospective, longitudinal pediatric studies. MIND currently integrates 16 cohorts worldwide, comprising (repeated) measures of DNA methylation in peripheral tissues (blood, buccal cells, and saliva) and neuroimaging by magnetic resonance imaging across up to five time points over a period of up to 21 years (N pooled DNAm = 12,877; N pooled neuroimaging = 10,899; N pooled combined = 6074). By triangulating associations across multiple developmental time points and study types, we hope to generate new insights into the dynamic relationships between peripheral DNA methylation and the brain, and how these ultimately relate to neurodevelopmental and psychiatric phenotypes.

items.title_zh: 甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟简介
items.summary_zh: 甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟旨在通过结合表观遗传学（epigenetics）和神经成像（neuroimaging）数据，探索外周表观遗传模式与大脑个体差异之间的关系。尽管表观遗传过程如DNA甲基化（DNA methylation）在预测心理健康和大脑表型方面显示出潜力，但目前的研究主要集中在成年人群的横断面研究。MIND联盟通过多队列分析促进协作性、充分有力的发展研究，建立共享流程和开放科学实践以提高科学严谨性，并利用前瞻性、纵向的儿童研究数据，推动对不同发展阶段（从出生到新兴成年）的DNA甲基化与大脑动态的理解。目前，MIND整合了全球16个队列的数据，涵盖了外周组织（血液、口腔细胞和唾液）中DNA甲基化的重复测量和多达五个时间点的磁共振成像（MRI）数据，研究时间跨度可达21年。
items.l1_lead: MIND联盟通过整合全球多队列的表观遗传和神经成像数据，旨在深入理解DNA甲基化与大脑发育之间的关系，推动心理健康研究的发展。
items.l2_summary:
甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟致力于通过结合表观遗传学（epigenetics）和神经成像（neuroimaging）数据，深入探讨外周表观遗传模式与大脑个体差异之间的关系。尽管DNA甲基化（DNA methylation）等表观遗传过程在预测心理健康和大脑表型方面展现出一定潜力，但现有研究主要集中于成年人群的横断面分析，缺乏对儿童及青少年发展阶段的纵向研究。为此，MIND联盟通过多队列分析的方式，促进跨学科的合作与研究，旨在建立共享流程和开放科学实践，以提高研究的科学严谨性。

MIND联盟的研究覆盖了全球16个队列的数据，整合了外周组织（如血液、口腔细胞和唾液）中DNA甲基化的重复测量，以及多达五个时间点的磁共振成像（MRI）数据，研究时间跨度可达21年。这种纵向的研究设计使得研究者能够更好地理解从出生到新兴成年不同发展阶段的DNA甲基化与大脑动态之间的关系。通过这些数据，MIND联盟希望能够揭示在不同发育阶段，外周表观遗传模式如何影响大脑的结构和功能，从而为心理健康的预测和干预提供新的视角和依据。

总之，MIND联盟的研究不仅填补了儿童和青少年领域的研究空白，还通过大规模的数据整合和跨学科的合作，推动了对表观遗传学与神经发育关系的深入理解，为未来的心理健康研究奠定了重要基础。

items.title: Exploring the relationships between Early Childhood Adversity, Social Cognition, and Aggression in a South African Study of People Living with Schizophrenia.
items.body: People living with schizophrenia (PLS) are at increased risk of being both victims and perpetrators of violence. Recent research suggests that social cognitive impairments may contribute to heightened aggression in schizophrenia. Childhood trauma, a well-established risk factor for both schizophrenia and aggression, is also linked to more severe cognitive deficits in PLS. Few studies have explored the relationships between childhood trauma, social cognition, and aggression in large sample sizes, particularly in low- and middle-income settings, where varying socioeconomic factors and exposure to violence may influence these associations. In this study, a subsample of participants (PLS = 585; controls = 882) from the Genomics of Schizophrenia in the South African Xhosa People study completed The Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (CTQ), Penn Emotion Identification Test (ER), Life History of Aggression Questionnaire (LHA), and Structured Diagnostic Interview for DSM-IV Axis I Disorders. Group differences in CTQ, ER, LHA, and selected demographic and clinical factors were assessed using t -tests and chi-square tests. Multivariable linear regressions were employed to test for associations among CTQ, ER, and LHA. We found that PLS had significantly higher childhood trauma and lifetime aggression scores and poorer emotion recognition performance than controls. Higher childhood trauma was associated with higher lifetime aggression and worse emotion recognition performance. However, emotion recognition performance was not associated with lifetime aggression. In this setting, childhood trauma predicts lifetime aggression and poorer emotion recognition, but there is no evidence that emotion recognition ability is related to aggression.
items.authors: van der Walt K, Wootton O, Rokicki J, Vaskinn A, Jonker D, Campbell M, Susser E, Haukvik UK, Gur RC, Stein DJ, Friestad C.
items.title_zh: 南非精神分裂症患者早期逆境、社会认知与攻击性关系研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了生活在南非的精神分裂症患者（PLS）与早期儿童创伤、社会认知及攻击性之间的关系。研究表明，精神分裂症患者在暴力受害者和施害者中风险增加，社会认知缺陷可能加剧其攻击性。儿童创伤作为精神分裂症和攻击性的已知风险因素，与PLS的认知缺陷严重程度相关。研究中，585名PLS和882名对照组参与者完成了儿童创伤问卷（CTQ）、宾州情感识别测试（ER）、攻击历史问卷（LHA）及DSM-IV轴I障碍结构化诊断访谈。结果显示，PLS在儿童创伤和终生攻击性得分上显著高于对照组，情感识别表现较差。研究强调了儿童创伤与攻击性之间的关联，提示在低中收入国家中需关注这些因素的影响。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，南非精神分裂症患者的早期儿童创伤与社会认知缺陷显著相关，且可能导致攻击性增加，提示需关注这些因素的影响。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨生活在南非的精神分裂症患者（PLS）与早期儿童创伤、社会认知及攻击性之间的关系。研究发现，精神分裂症患者在暴力受害者和施害者中面临更高的风险，而社会认知缺陷可能进一步加剧其攻击性行为。儿童创伤作为精神分裂症和攻击性的已知风险因素，与PLS的认知缺陷严重程度存在显著相关性。

在研究中，共有585名PLS和882名对照组参与者参与了调查，完成了儿童创伤问卷（CTQ）、宾州情感识别测试（ER）、攻击历史问卷（LHA）及DSM-IV轴I障碍结构化诊断访谈。结果显示，PLS在儿童创伤和终生攻击性得分上显著高于对照组，且在情感识别测试中的表现也较差。这些数据表明，早期儿童创伤不仅与精神分裂症的发生相关，也与攻击性行为的增加密切相关。

研究强调了儿童创伤与攻击性之间的关联，提示在低中收入国家中，尤其需要关注这些因素的影响，以便为精神分裂症患者提供更有效的干预和支持。这一发现为理解精神分裂症患者的攻击性行为提供了新的视角，并为未来的研究和临床实践提供了重要的参考依据。

items.title: Advanced Oral Delivery Systems for Nutraceuticals.
items.body: Oral delivery is the most preferred route for nutraceuticals due to its convenience and high patient compliance. However, bioavailability is often compromised by poor solubility, instability, and first-pass metabolism in the gastrointestinal tract. This review examines current and emerging oral delivery platforms designed to overcome these barriers and enhance nutraceutical efficacy. Traditional carriers-proteins, lipids, and carbohydrates-highlighting their delivery mechanisms and limitations, are first explored. Advancements in material science have led to novel platforms such as biodegradable polymers, metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), metal-polyphenol networks (MPNs), and 3D printing technologies. Biodegradable polymers improve stability and enable controlled release of bioactives. MOFs offer high surface area and tunable porosity for encapsulating and protecting sensitive compounds. MPNs provide biocompatible, stimuli-responsive systems for targeted nutrient delivery. Meanwhile, 3D printing facilitates the fabrication of personalized delivery systems with precise control over composition and release kinetics, especially when integrated with artificial intelligence (AI) for precision nutrition. By comparing traditional and next-generation strategies, this review outlines key design principles for optimizing oral delivery systems. The transformative potential of these innovations is underscored to improve the bioavailability and therapeutic outcomes of nutraceuticals, ultimately advancing personalized and targeted nutrition solutions.
items.authors: Yang X, Zhang L, Zheng Z, Langer R, Jaklenec A.
items.title_zh: 先进的营养补充剂口服递送系统
items.summary_zh: 口服递送因其便利性和高患者依从性而成为营养补充剂的首选途径。然而，生物利用度常因溶解度差、不稳定性及首过效应而受到影响。本文评述了当前及新兴的口服递送平台，旨在克服这些障碍并增强营养补充剂的功效。首先探讨了传统载体（如蛋白质、脂质和碳水化合物）的递送机制及其局限性。材料科学的进步催生了生物可降解聚合物、金属有机框架（MOFs）、金属-多酚网络（MPNs）及3D打印技术等新平台。生物可降解聚合物提高了稳定性并实现生物活性物质的控制释放；MOFs则提供了高表面积和可调孔隙率以包封和保护敏感化合物；MPNs提供了生物相容性和刺激响应的系统以实现靶向营养递送；而3D打印则便于制造个性化递送系统，尤其在与人工智能（AI）结合时，能够实现精准营养。通过比较传统与新一代策略，本文概述了优化口服递送系统的关键设计原则。
items.l1_lead: 先进的口服递送系统通过新材料和技术的应用，克服了传统营养补充剂在生物利用度上的限制，提升了其稳定性和靶向性。
items.l2_summary:
口服递送系统因其便利性和高患者依从性，成为营养补充剂的主要选择。然而，营养补充剂的生物利用度常常受到溶解度差、不稳定性及首过效应等因素的影响。为了解决这些问题，本文评述了当前及新兴的口服递送平台，旨在提升营养补充剂的功效。首先，文章探讨了传统载体（如蛋白质、脂质和碳水化合物）的递送机制及其局限性，这些传统方法在提高生物利用度方面存在一定的挑战。

随着材料科学的进步，出现了多种新型递送平台，包括生物可降解聚合物、金属有机框架（MOFs）、金属-多酚网络（MPNs）及3D打印技术等。这些新平台在解决传统方法的不足方面展现出良好的前景。生物可降解聚合物通过提高稳定性和实现生物活性物质的控制释放，显著改善了营养补充剂的递送效果。MOFs则因其高表面积和可调孔隙率，能够有效包封和保护敏感化合物，从而提高其生物利用度。MPNs提供了良好的生物相容性和刺激响应的系统，能够实现靶向营养递送，进一步增强了营养补充剂的效果。此外，3D打印技术的应用使得个性化递送系统的制造变得更加便捷，尤其是在与人工智能（AI）结合时，能够实现精准营养的目标。

通过对传统与新一代策略的比较，本文总结了优化口服递送系统的关键设计原则，强调了新型递送平台在提升营养补充剂生物利用度方面的重要性。这些创新技术不仅为营养补充剂的开发提供了新的思路，也为未来的研究和应用奠定了基础。总之，随着新型递送系统的不断发展，营养补充剂的口服递送效果有望得到显著改善，从而更好地满足患者的需求。

items.title: Enhancing immunotherapy with tumour-responsive nanomaterials.
items.body: The targeted delivery of immunotherapies to tumours using tumour-responsive nanomaterials is a promising area of cancer research with the potential to address the limitations of systemic administration such as on-target off-tumour toxicities and a lack of activity owing to the immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment (TME). Attempts to address these challenges include the design and functionalization of nanomaterials capable of releasing their cargoes in response to specific TME characteristics, thus facilitating the targeted delivery of immune-checkpoint inhibitors, cytokines, mRNAs, vaccines and, potentially, chimaeric antigen receptors as well as of agents that modulate the extracellular matrix and induce immunogenic cell death. In this Review, we describe these various research efforts in the context of the dynamic properties of the TME, such as pH, reductive conditions, reactive oxygen species, hypoxia, specific enzymes, high levels of ATP and locoregional aspects, which can be leveraged to enhance the specificity and efficacy of nanomaterial-based immunotherapies. Highlighting preclinical successes and ongoing clinical trials, we evaluate the current landscape and potential of these innovative approaches. We also consider future research directions as well as the most important barriers to successful clinical translation, emphasizing the transformative potential of tumour-responsive nanomaterials in overcoming the barriers that limit the activity of traditional immunotherapies, thus improving patient outcomes.
items.authors: Linderman SW, DeRidder L, Sanjurjo L, Foote MB, Alonso MJ, Kirtane AR, Langer R, Traverso G.
items.title_zh: 利用肿瘤响应纳米材料增强免疫疗法
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了利用肿瘤响应纳米材料实现免疫疗法靶向递送的研究进展。这一领域旨在解决全身给药的局限性，如靶向外的肿瘤毒性和免疫抑制的肿瘤微环境（TME）导致的活性不足。研究者们设计并功能化纳米材料，使其能够根据特定的TME特征释放药物，从而实现免疫检查点抑制剂、细胞因子、mRNA、疫苗及潜在的嵌合抗原受体的靶向递送。此外，纳米材料还可用于调节细胞外基质和诱导免疫原性细胞死亡。文章强调了TME的动态特性（如pH、还原条件、活性氧、缺氧等）在增强纳米材料基础免疫疗法的特异性和有效性方面的应用，评估了当前的研究成果及临床试验，并探讨了未来的研究方向及临床转化的主要障碍。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，肿瘤响应纳米材料能够有效增强免疫疗法的靶向递送，克服传统全身给药的局限性，提高治疗特异性和有效性。
items.l2_summary:
本文评述了利用肿瘤响应纳米材料（tumor-responsive nanomaterials）增强免疫疗法的研究进展，旨在解决全身给药的局限性，包括靶向外的肿瘤毒性和免疫抑制的肿瘤微环境（tumor microenvironment, TME）导致的活性不足。研究者们通过设计和功能化纳米材料，使其能够根据特定的TME特征（如pH、还原条件、活性氧、缺氧等）释放药物，从而实现对免疫检查点抑制剂、细胞因子、mRNA、疫苗及潜在的嵌合抗原受体（CAR）的靶向递送。这种方法不仅提高了药物的靶向性，还能有效降低对正常组织的毒性。

文章强调了TME的动态特性在增强纳米材料基础免疫疗法的特异性和有效性方面的重要应用。通过调节细胞外基质和诱导免疫原性细胞死亡，纳米材料能够进一步改善免疫反应的效果。当前的研究成果显示，利用肿瘤响应纳米材料的免疫疗法在临床试验中展现出良好的前景，但仍面临一些主要障碍，如纳米材料的生物相容性、体内分布和长期安全性等问题。

此外，文章还探讨了未来的研究方向，建议在纳米材料的设计中进一步考虑TME的复杂性，以提高治疗的个体化和精准性。总体而言，肿瘤响应纳米材料在增强免疫疗法方面的应用具有广阔的前景，能够为癌症治疗提供新的思路和方法。

items.title: Adaptive consolidation of active inference: excitatory and inhibitory mechanisms for organizing feedforward and feedback memory systems in sleep.
items.body: Cognitive self-organization rests on activity-dependent plasticity to extend the ontogenetic process of neural differentiation and integration of the cerebral cortex in each act of cognition. This account of neurocognitive growth can be formulated in terms of active inference and learning. The organism regulates synaptic connectivity as it seeks its goals actively, through excitatory, feedforward expectancies that manifest its species-specific affordances. These adaptive expectancies are modified reactively, through inhibitory feedback error-correction to fit and predict environmental encounters. Although adaptive behavior, and concomitant synaptic plasticity, occur during waking, the synaptic architecture requires ongoing consolidation and refinement during sleep. We propose that memory consolidation during sleep is a continuation of the neurodevelopmental process that proceeds through a kind of inversion of waking active inference: NREM sleep first refines the brain's representations of new, unpredicted experiences during waking, implementing inhibitory mechanisms of long-term depression that both differentiate and stabilize new representations for consolidation. REM sleep then updates the organism's generative world model in light of this new learning through excitatory long-term potentiation of synaptic plasticity. REM thereby reconsolidates and integrates the organism's adaptive, feedforward predictions, the Bayesian priors for effective coping.
items.authors: Tucker DM, Luu P, Friston KJ.
items.title_zh: 主动推理的适应性巩固：睡眠中记忆系统的兴奋与抑制机制
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了认知自组织如何依赖于活动依赖性可塑性，以促进大脑皮层在认知过程中的神经分化与整合。作者提出，生物体在追求目标时，通过兴奋性前馈预期调节突触连接，并通过抑制性反馈错误修正来适应环境。尽管在清醒状态下会发生适应性行为和突触可塑性，但突触结构在睡眠中需要持续巩固与精炼。文章建议，睡眠中的记忆巩固是神经发育过程的延续，NREM睡眠通过抑制性机制细化清醒时的新经验表示，而REM睡眠则通过兴奋性长期增强更新生物体的生成世界模型，从而实现记忆的再巩固与整合。
items.l1_lead: 睡眠中的记忆巩固通过兴奋与抑制机制，促进大脑神经连接的适应性调整，支持认知自组织与环境适应。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了认知自组织如何依赖于活动依赖性可塑性，以促进大脑皮层在认知过程中的神经分化与整合。作者指出，生物体在追求目标时，通过兴奋性前馈预期调节突触连接，并通过抑制性反馈错误修正来适应环境。这一过程在清醒状态下表现为适应性行为和突触可塑性，但突触结构在睡眠中需要持续的巩固与精炼。文章强调，睡眠中的记忆巩固是神经发育过程的延续，尤其是非快速眼动睡眠（NREM）通过抑制性机制细化清醒时的新经验表示，而快速眼动睡眠（REM）则通过兴奋性长期增强（LTP）更新生物体的生成世界模型，从而实现记忆的再巩固与整合。

研究表明，NREM睡眠在记忆巩固中起着关键作用，能够通过抑制性神经元的活动来优化和整合信息，使得大脑能够更有效地处理和存储新获得的经验。同时，REM睡眠则通过兴奋性机制促进信息的更新和重组，使得生物体能够在不断变化的环境中保持适应性。作者的论点得到了多项实验研究的支持，这些研究表明，睡眠阶段的不同特征与记忆的不同类型和整合过程密切相关。

综上所述，本文揭示了睡眠在记忆系统中的重要作用，强调了兴奋与抑制机制在认知自组织中的适应性巩固过程。这一研究为理解大脑如何在不同状态下处理和整合信息提供了新的视角，指出了睡眠在认知功能中的不可或缺性。

items.title: Pathfinding: a neurodynamical account of intuition.
items.body: We examine the neurobiology of intuition, a term often inconsistently defined in scientific literature. While researchers generally agree that intuition represents "an experienced-based process resulting in a spontaneous tendency toward a hunch or hypothesis," we establish a firmer neurobiological foundation by framing intuition evolutionarily as a pathfinding mechanism emerging from the brain's optimization of its relationship with the environment. Our review synthesizes empirical findings on intuition's neurobiological basis, including relevant brain networks and their relationship to cognitive states like insight. We propose that unsolved problems dynamically alter attractor landscapes, guiding future intuitions. We investigate "opportunistic assimilation" through nonlinear neurodynamics and identify hippocampal sharp wave ripples as potential neural correlates of intuition, citing their role in creativity, choice, action planning, and abstract thinking. Finally, we explore intuition through two complementary perspectives: the free energy principle, which models brains as minimizing uncertainty through predictive hierarchical coding, and metastable coordination dynamics, describing the brain's simultaneous tendencies toward regional cooperation and functional autonomy. Together, these principles provide a comprehensive neurodynamical account of intuition's neurophenomenology.
items.authors: Kotler S, Mannino M, Friston K, Buzsáki G, Kelso JAS, Dumas G.
items.title_zh: 直觉的神经动力学探讨
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了直觉的神经生物学，直觉常在科学文献中定义不一致。研究者普遍认为，直觉是“基于经验的过程，导致对直觉或假设的自发倾向”。我们从进化的角度将直觉视为一种路径寻找机制，源于大脑与环境关系的优化。文章综合了直觉的神经生物学基础的实证研究，包括相关脑网络及其与洞察等认知状态的关系。我们提出未解决的问题动态改变吸引子景观，引导未来的直觉。通过非线性神经动力学研究“机会性同化”，并识别海马体尖波涟漪作为直觉的潜在神经相关物，强调其在创造力、选择、行动规划和抽象思维中的作用。最后，我们从自由能原理和亚稳态协调动力学两个互补视角探讨直觉，前者将大脑视为通过预测层级编码最小化不确定性，后者描述大脑在区域合作与功能自主之间的同时倾向。这些原理共同提供了直觉神经现象学的全面神经动力学解释。
items.l1_lead: 本文探讨直觉的神经生物学，提出直觉作为一种基于经验的路径寻找机制，并通过非线性神经动力学揭示其在创造力和决策中的重要作用。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了直觉的神经生物学，指出直觉在科学文献中的定义存在不一致性。研究者普遍认为，直觉是一种“基于经验的过程，导致对直觉或假设的自发倾向”。从进化的角度来看，直觉被视为一种路径寻找机制，源于大脑与环境关系的优化。文章综合了直觉的神经生物学基础的实证研究，探讨了相关脑网络及其与洞察等认知状态的关系。

研究中提出，未解决的问题动态改变吸引子景观，这一过程引导未来的直觉发展。通过非线性神经动力学的研究，文章探讨了“机会性同化”的概念，并识别出海马体尖波涟漪作为直觉的潜在神经相关物，强调其在创造力、选择、行动规划和抽象思维中的重要作用。这些发现为理解直觉的神经机制提供了新的视角。

最后，文章从自由能原理（free energy principle）和亚稳态协调动力学（metastable coordination dynamics）两个互补视角探讨直觉。自由能原理将大脑视为通过预测层级编码来最小化不确定性，而亚稳态协调动力学则描述了大脑在区域合作与功能自主之间的平衡倾向。这些理论共同为直觉的神经现象学提供了全面的神经动力学解释，揭示了直觉在复杂认知过程中的核心作用。

items.title: Genetic Evidence for a Neuroimmune Model of Schizophrenia.
items.body: Since the early 1900s, clinical and epidemiological observations have suggested a link between schizophrenia and the immune system, yet genetic evidence for a pathophysiological connection has remained elusive. Here, we review evidence for immune involvement from a variety of genetic studies to characterize the contribution of genetic variation in immune genes and pathways to schizophrenia risk. Across studies, the strongest and most consistent associations remain in neuronal pathways, but several studies have revealed involvement of peripheral lymphocyte populations, including CD4+ T cells, mature B cells, and, to a lesser extent, natural killer (NK) cells. Cross-trait genetic analyses are mixed but point to a modest shared genetic architecture between schizophrenia and several immune traits. Collectively, current evidence supports a primarily neuronal genetic architecture for schizophrenia with a modest immunogenetic component. Advancing our understanding of the immune contribution to schizophrenia risk will require integration of genomic, proteomic, and deep immunophenotyping approaches to capture these subtle and dynamic processes. Ultimately, combining genetic, immunologic, and clinical data will be essential for improving diagnostic precision, identifying novel therapeutic targets, and tailoring treatment to individual biological profiles.
items.authors: van der Walt K, Stein DJ, Zoghbi AW.
items.title_zh: 精神分裂症的神经免疫模型的遗传证据
items.summary_zh: 自20世纪初以来，临床和流行病学观察表明精神分裂症与免疫系统之间存在联系，但遗传证据仍然难以捉摸。本文回顾了多项遗传研究中关于免疫参与的证据，旨在阐明免疫基因和通路的遗传变异对精神分裂症风险的贡献。研究表明，最强且一致的关联主要集中在神经通路上，但也有研究揭示了外周淋巴细胞群体（包括CD4+ T细胞、成熟B细胞及自然杀伤（NK）细胞）的参与。跨性状遗传分析结果不一，但指向精神分裂症与多种免疫特征之间存在适度的共享遗传结构。总体而言，现有证据支持精神分裂症主要由神经遗传结构主导，伴有适度的免疫遗传成分。深入理解免疫对精神分裂症风险的贡献需要整合基因组学、蛋白质组学和深度免疫表型分析，以捕捉这些微妙而动态的过程。最终，结合遗传、免疫和临床数据对于提高诊断精度、识别新治疗靶点以及个性化治疗至关重要。
items.l1_lead: 精神分裂症的风险主要由神经遗传结构主导，同时伴有适度的免疫遗传成分，深入研究免疫对其影响有助于提高诊断和治疗的精准性。
items.l2_summary:
自20世纪初以来，精神分裂症与免疫系统之间的关系引起了广泛关注，尽管遗传证据仍然难以捉摸。本文回顾了多项遗传研究，探讨免疫基因和通路的遗传变异对精神分裂症风险的贡献。研究发现，精神分裂症与神经通路之间的关联最为强烈且一致，同时也有证据表明外周淋巴细胞群体（如CD4+ T细胞、成熟B细胞及自然杀伤（NK）细胞）在此过程中发挥了重要作用。跨性状遗传分析的结果虽然不尽相同，但普遍指向精神分裂症与多种免疫特征之间存在适度的共享遗传结构。

总体而言，现有证据支持精神分裂症主要由神经遗传结构主导，同时伴有适度的免疫遗传成分。这一发现提示我们，深入理解免疫对精神分裂症风险的贡献，需要整合基因组学、蛋白质组学和深度免疫表型分析，以捕捉这些复杂而动态的生物过程。最终，将遗传、免疫和临床数据结合起来，对于提高精神分裂症的诊断精度、识别新的治疗靶点以及实现个性化治疗具有重要意义。这些研究不仅为精神分裂症的病因提供了新的视角，也为未来的治疗策略奠定了基础。

items.title: New Genomics Discoveries Across the Bipolar Disorder Spectrum Implicate Neurobiological and Developmental Pathways.
items.body: Bipolar disorder (BD) is a highly heritable mental disorder that affects millions of people worldwide. Our understanding of the genetic etiology and biological processes that underlie BD have greatly increased in recent years. Extensive progress has been made in identifying common variant signals for BD, and the polygenic score from the latest genome-wide association study (GWAS) may provide some clinical utility if combined with other risk factors for BD. The role of rare variation in BD remains to be determined, although genes annotated to common variant loci are shown to be enriched for rare variation. BD subtypes have been shown to differ in their genetic architecture, and as such, genetic studies across the subtypes of the BD spectrum will identify subtype-specific signals and reveal subtype-specific biological mechanisms. Despite this, subtype-specific GWAS sample sizes have not increased at the same rate as BD cases, and more concerted efforts are required to obtain this information for participants included in future BD GWASs. Moreover, assessment of culture, geography, and other systematic differences that may impact patient assessment will be necessary to ensure accurate inclusion of diverse ancestral groups and global representation in genetic studies of BD moving forward.
